answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with a hash-chained commitment vault: each identity seals its next work plan in a vault before acting, then reveals it the following epoch, so its history grows ring by ring like a cedar. A contradiction between the sealed plan and the revealed work is a loud fraud signal, and the identity loses standing. A farm must invent a separate, consistent history for every fake, paying real planning and execution cost per identity, while one honest agent pays only a single hash and one reveal per epoch.
